purpose: DCLGEN for DB2 table CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS (authorization fraud records): the EXEC SQL DECLARE TABLE with 26 columns and the COBOL host structure DCLAUTHFRDS. It is included by COPAUS2C, which inserts a copy of a pending authorization detail with its fraud flag when a user reports or removes fraud in COPAUS1C, or updates the flag and report date when the row already exists. The primary key per the DDL is (CARD_NUM, AUTH_TS).

key_fields.name: CARD-NUM
key_fields.meaning: Host variable for CARD_NUM CHAR(16), first primary-key column.

key_fields.name: AUTH-TS
key_fields.meaning: Host variable X(26) for AUTH_TS TIMESTAMP, second primary-key column; COPAUS2C fills it via TIMESTAMP_FORMAT.

key_fields.name: FRAUD-RPT-DATE
key_fields.meaning: Fraud report DATE; COPAUS2C uses CURRENT DATE rather than this host variable.

key_fields.name: MERCHANT-NAME
key_fields.meaning: VARCHAR(22) group with 49-level length and text.

observations.text: DCLGEN header comments name table AWSTSSC.AUTHFRDS while the DECLARE and the DDL use CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS; the library name is a placeholder (XXXXXXX.DB2.DCLGEN).
PROCESSING_CODE is CHAR(6) in DB2 while the IMS detail field PA-PROCESSING-CODE is PIC 9(06); POS_ENTRY_MODE is SMALLINT vs 9(02) in IMS. Conversions happen via MOVE in COPAUS2C.
